$comment: Shared by the PHP and TypeScript rule evaluators. See docs/SCHEMA.md section 11. Generated shape: each case has fields, rules, values, and expect.visible / expect.required (sorted field ID lists).

cases.name: no rules: all visible, required follows field.required
show rule: target hidden when condition is false
show rule: target visible when condition is true
show rule: missing source value keeps target hidden
hide rule hides target when true
hide rule keeps target visible when false
hide wins over show
several show rules: any matching rule shows the target (second matches)
several show rules: no matching rule keeps target hidden
require rule: required when condition is true
require rule: not required when condition is false
hidden field is never required (hide rule)
required field hidden by a show rule is not required
require rule on a hidden target is ignored
several require rules: either one makes the field required
one rule with several targets
chain: everything visible when each link matches
chain: a hidden source reads as empty, even with a submitted value
declaration order: reverse order, all links match
declaration order: reverse order, hidden middle link
hidden source with neq: empty source makes neq true
missing source with neq is true
text eq: case-insensitive and trimmed
text eq: trims Unicode whitespace such as NBSP
text eq: lowercases non-ASCII letters
text eq: different text does not match
textarea contains: case-insensitive substring
text contains: false when empty
text not_contains: true when empty
text not_contains: false when the text contains it
text empty: whitespace-only text counts as empty
text not_empty: true for real text
text with a non-string value counts as empty
email behaves like text
url behaves like text
text in: matches a listed value after normalizing
text not_in: excludes listed values
number gt: true above the limit
number gt: false at the limit
number gte: true at the limit
number lt: false at the limit
number lte: true at the limit
number accepts numeric strings
number: non-numeric string counts as empty
number: exponent form counts as empty
number eq: float-formatted string equals the integer
number neq: empty value is not equal
number in: listed value
select eq: exact, case-sensitive
radio eq: matches
select in: listed value matches
select in: unlisted value does not match
select not_in: listed value is excluded
select not_in: unlisted value passes
select with a non-string value counts as empty
operator not valid for the type evaluates to false
checkboxes contains: selected option
checkboxes contains: option not selected
checkboxes not_contains: option not selected
checkboxes empty: empty list counts as empty
checkboxes not_empty: at least one selected
checkbox eq false: unchecked box matches
checkbox eq false: missing value does not match
date gt: later date
date eq: same date
date: invalid string counts as empty
time lt: earlier time
time lt: false at the limit
phone eq: ignores spaces and punctuation
phone eq: plus sign is significant
phone eq: local number with dots
nested any/all: inner all matches
nested any/all: inner all fails and outer leaf fails
nested any/all: outer leaf matches alone
display field is hidden by a show rule
display field is shown by a show rule and is never required
file not_empty: an uploaded file shows the target
file not_empty: no files keeps the target hidden
file not_empty: empty list counts as no files
